memory_objects.content: The memory update process is sequential. After an initial memory is created, each subsequent meeting's process will take the previous memory as input. When an item is revisited, it is updated by adding the new meeting ID and supplementing its content.

memory_objects.content: A forgetting mechanism is part of the system design. Memory items that are not discussed for a specified number of meetings (e.g., three) will be automatically deleted.
memory_objects.evidence: [SPEAKER_01]: 上一次在 16 這個 meeting 的紀錄都要再往前推，它就會變成一週前、兩週前。可是它現在記錄的是 meeting ID，所以不行。以這個點來說，它的 meeting 現在是 16，更新後就會改成 17；沒有更新時就是 16。因為我們現在設定的是前三次，所以完成 16 之後，如果超過這個範圍就會被處理掉。 [SPEAKER_01]: 如果這個點在三次內都沒有被討論，它應該就會把它刪掉。

memory_objects.content: The system will use static meeting IDs to track memory items. A proposed alternative of using a relative timeline (e.g., 'one week ago') was rejected due to incompatibility with the current implementation.

memory_objects.content: The memory update mechanism is sequential: a subsequent meeting takes the existing memory from the previous meeting as input and updates it. When an item is discussed again, the system adds the new meeting ID and supplements its content.

memory_objects.content: A three-tiered memory architecture has been adopted, consisting of: 1) Working Memory (real-time), 2) Short-Term Memory (important points from the last 3 meetings), and 3) a separate, coarser-grained Long-Term Memory designed to track the high-level project trajectory.

memory_objects.content: The Long-Term Memory (LTM) will be a separate, coarser-grained architecture to track the project's long-term trajectory, capturing high-level elements like goals and milestones, distinguishing it from a more granular approach focused on information validity.

memory_objects.content: An argument was made that the current short-term memory (STM), which spans three meetings, could already be considered a form of long-term memory (LTM). The reasoning is that it persists beyond a single session, making its history longer than the LTM in the reference paper.

memory_objects.content: The project's primary goal and evaluation method is focused on understanding the memory-enhanced agent's effect on human perception, rather than on rigorous proof. The minimum viable approach is to implement the architecture, show behavior changes, and observe human interaction.
